# CodeMissionDraft represents a JSON object that describes a code mission.
# Based on the provided information, this function generates the CodeMissionDraft JSON structure.

def generate_code_mission_draft(
    type: str,
    mission: str,
    repo: str,
    branch: str,
    requirements: List[str],
    constraints: List[str],
    non_goals: List[str],
    priority: str,
    complexity: str,
    thomas_notes: str
) -> dict:
    code_mission_draft = {
        "type": type,
        "mission": mission,
        "repo": repo,
        "branch": branch,
        "requirements": requirements,
        "constraints": constraints,
        "non_goals": non_goals,
        "priority": priority,
        "complexity": complexity,
        "thomas_notes": thomas_notes
    }
    return code_mission_draft

# Example usage:
code_mission_draft = generate_code_mission_draft(
    type="CodeMissionDraft",
    mission="Add auth",
    repo="https://github.com/example/auth",
    branch="main",
    requirements=["JWT tokens"],
    constraints=["PBKDF2 hashing"],
    non_goals=["OAuth", "SSO", "rate limiting"],
    priority="P1",
    complexity="med",
    thomas_notes="Future ideas: OAuth2 next quarter."
)

print(code_mission_draft)
